answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 678 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the forge log shows the live set and the sonnet audit records each lapse. Keeping 249 aliases alive thus means 249 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the grove quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 12 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
